name: Feishu / Lark
summary: Post messages from Ogun workflows to a Feishu or Lark group through a custom bot webhook. The token at the end of the URL is the secret.

fields.name: webhook_url
fields.label: Webhook URL
fields.help: The bot's URL on open.feishu.cn or open.larksuite.com. It is a secret. Store it with ogun secrets set.

fields.name: signing_secret
fields.label: Signing secret
fields.help: Only when signature verification is on for the bot. Used to sign; never sent.

egress.note: Feishu accounts use open.feishu.cn; Lark accounts use open.larksuite.com. The host of the webhook URL decides.

operators.summary: Post a text message to the Feishu or Lark group the custom bot belongs to.

notes: The bot's token is part of the webhook URL, so the whole URL is stored as a secret and never reaches logs, events or lineage. A custom bot can also be set to require a keyword or an IP allowlist; check its security settings in the app.

implementation.evidence: Sink in ogun-export, written from public documentation and checked against a local fake in unit tests; not run against the real service.
